title: Working Zones Introduction and Seal Ring's Housing
topics: Bearing and seal ring assembly with same fitting diameter
rules: Minimum effective dimension 'a' = 1 mm unless dimensioning doesn't allow larger value (Bonfiglioli tolerances: a = 2 mm)
Effective minimum 'a = 1' must be used where dimension doesn't allow larger dimensioning (Consensus: a ≤ 2 mm)
Seal ring assembly must be followed by bearing assembly when dc = da (same fitting diameter)
Bearing assembly must be followed by seal ring in reverse case
Every zone must indicate the specific tolerance and roughness values
On specific zones the useful assembly length must remain indicated
Rounded edge/rounded side indication means there must be sharp roughness
Sharp edge indication with 'spigolo arrotondato e/o estremita arrotondata' means no sharp edges allowed
dimensions: a = 1 mm (minimum effective) where larger dimensioning not allowed
Chamfer depth related to housing zones
tolerances: Radius R based on diameter: ød ≤ 60 → R = 0.4 mm
Radius R based on diameter: > 60 ÷ 120 → R = 0.8 mm
Radius R based on diameter: > 120 → R = 1.2 mm
Zone-specific tolerances must be indicated on all working zones
surface_finish: Ra ≤ 0.8 for seal ring housing surfaces
Surface finish must be indicated on each zone
Surface possibly with 'plunge grinding' machining and without roughness a/o helical rilings
Roughness values must be specified for each working zone
inspection: Verify minimum effective dimension 'a' is maintained
Check radius R according to diameter ranges
Verify tolerance zones are properly indicated
Confirm roughness specifications on all working zones
Check assembly sequence when bearing and seal share fitting diameter
manufacturing_notes: Working zone introduction requires careful dimensional control
Chamfer and radius must follow diameter-dependent specifications
When bearing and seal ring have same fitting diameter (dc = da), assembly sequence is critical
Seal ring must be assembled before bearing in same-diameter scenarios
Sharp edges must be avoided where rounded edge symbol is indicated
Plunge grinding may be required for specific surface finish requirements
training_guidance: When modeling seal ring housing in NX, create working zone with minimum 1 mm effective dimension 'a', preferably 2 mm when space allows
Apply chamfer radius R based on bore diameter: 0.4 mm for ø≤60, 0.8 mm for ø60-120, 1.2 mm for ø>120
For bearing and seal combinations with identical fitting diameter, model seal seat before bearing seat in assembly sequence
Add annotations to indicate specific tolerance zones and surface finish requirements (Ra ≤ 0.8) on seal housing surfaces
Include edge break/radius features at transitions to avoid sharp edges unless specifically required for roughness
Model separate zones L (total) and L1 (useful assembly length) with appropriate dimensional callouts
Ensure all working zones have tolerance and surface finish annotations for manufacturing clarity
summary: This standard defines working zone requirements for seal ring housings in Bonfiglioli gearbox assemblies. Key specifications include minimum effective dimensions (a = 1-2 mm), diameter-dependent chamfer radii (R = 0.4-1.2 mm), and surface finish requirements (Ra ≤ 0.8). When bearings and seal rings share the same fitting diameter, the seal ring must be assembled first, followed by the bearing, with all zones clearly annotated with specific tolerances and roughness values.
